需要上传的认证文件，
上传方式：通过构造InputStream上传文件。
description.en: The certificate file to upload. Construct an InputStream to upload the file.

description.zh:
证书文件名称。
在一个项目空间中，
证书文件名称不允许重复。
description.en: The name of the certificate file. The name must be unique within a project.
The ID of the project to which the certificate file belongs.

descriptions.zh:
1. 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
2. 需要在DataWorks项目空间中具有如下至少一种角色： 租户所有者、空间管理员、项目所有者、运维
descriptions.en:
1. This feature requires DataWorks Basic Edition or a later version.

2. You must be assigned one of the following roles in the DataWorks project: Tenant Owner, Space Administrator, Project Owner, or O\&M.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public import-certificate --project-id 106560 --name ca1.crt --certificate-file - --description This_is_a_file --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
